hazard: Fragmented service provision for co-occurring substance misuse and mental health issues
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Philip Denning
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Patients with both substance misuse and mental health issues used to be managed under the same 'umbrella' - ie by Nottinghamshire Healthcare. Since October 2014, Nottinghamshire Healthcare has only dealt with a small subsection of these patients (broadly speaking, those with severe and enduring mental illness).
concerns.hazard: fragmented service provision for co-occurring substance misuse and mental health issues

concerns.quote: The CRI is an entirely separate entity from Nottinghamshire Healthcare and has no access to RiO, Nottingham Healthcare's electronic record-keeping system. If, for instance, one of their patients had been seen regularly by Nottinghamshire Healthcare following overdoses, they would not be aware of this unless their patient told them about this.
concerns.hazard: information silo between substance misuse and mental health services

concerns.quote: It is also clear that there is a significant lack of understanding in primary care about how to access help for patients like Philip. The respective roles of CRI, Nottinghamshire Healthcare and primary care talking therapies appear to be widely misunderstood.
concerns.hazard: primary care misunderstanding of service pathways for dual-diagnosis patients

promises.quote: The NHS Long Term Plan, published earlier this year, details how new and integrated models of primary and community health services will transform the delivery of mental health care for adults and older adults with SMI, including people with a 'personality disorder' and those with co-existing substance misuse. promises.summary: Publish integrated care models for SMI and substance misuse by 2023/24

concerns.quote: There are no resources and no system of treatment for people who present with serious mental ilIness and aicohol or drug misuse histories
concerns.hazard: lack of resources and treatment system for serious mental illness and substance misuse

concerns.quote: insufficient sharing of information between the Mental Health Trust and CGL (the Substance and Alcohol Misuse Service)
concerns.hazard: insufficient information sharing between Mental Health Trust and CGL

concerns.quote: That latter service is voluntary and, outside the criminal justice system, the subject cannot be forced to access and receive help or to cooperate with that service
concerns.hazard: voluntary nature of substance misuse service preventing compulsory treatment

concerns.quote: The Mental Health Act still concentrates on therapy without giving sufficient emphasis, in my view, to safety and, in blunt terms, keeping people alive
concerns.hazard: Mental Health Act insufficient focus on safety and life preservation

concerns.quote: without action these issues are simply going to get worse
concerns.hazard: lack of preventive action leading to worsening issues
